title: 第一卷 第7章 真相的残酷
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

关闭了交易频道，秦龙躺在了床上。

这一天，简直是刺激。

根本没有想过，有一天，会来到这样的一个地方。

既来之则安之。

有了S级天赋铭刻之主，就算在这样一个末世里面，他也要活得精彩！

点开了区域聊天频道，他看向了右上角的人数显示。

6215！

只剩下了六千多人！

刚才天黑的时候，他就想到了这个问题。

没想到比自己预想的还要恐怖。

仅仅是一天的时间，就已经死了接近四千人！

这只是一个区域里面，所有的区域加起来呢！

这是一个恐怖的死亡数字。

白天还没有这么多人。

只是在天黑的瞬间，死亡人数飙升！

他知道，最残酷的事情发生了，那些婴儿，小孩，老人，残疾。

他们没有能力将木屋升级，没有能力能够移动木屋一公里。

在天黑的瞬间，全都被抹杀了！

这是一个极为残酷的事情。

连秦龙这样的单身都觉得胸口压了一块大石头。

更何况是那些作为父母的。

他们的心中，此时怕已经心死了。

这就是该死的末世，残酷到极致！

“吼，刺啦，桀桀...”

外面忽然就响起了很多的恐怖声音。

甚至大地都有点震动的感觉。

黑夜降临，此时外面的世界，就像是群魔乱舞的感觉。

各种嘶吼声，响成一片！

还有肌肉被撕裂的声音，黑夜的生物，相互之间应该也有厮杀！

在这种声音之下，胆小一点的都要被吓死了。

秦龙透过驾驶位置的观察孔看了一下外面。

借着丧尸燃烧的火光，隐约看到了一些东西。

绿色的眼睛，红色的眼睛，都在火光外面乍现一下。

没有看清到底是什么。

黑夜的生物，果然是惧怕火光的。

有火光在，他们就不敢靠近木屋。

现在，秦龙更觉得木屋升级的重要性，要放在第一位置。

随着夜幕降临，木屋里面的温度也在急剧下降！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After closing the trading channel, Qin Long lay on the bed.

This day was simply exciting.

I never thought that one day I would come to such a place.

As soon as it comes, make peace with it.

With the S-level talent of the Master of Engraving, he must live a wonderful life even in such an apocalyptic world!

He clicked on the regional chat channel and looked at the number of people displayed in the upper right corner.

6215!

There are only more than 6,000 people left!

He thought of this problem just now when it got dark.

Unexpectedly, it was more terrifying than I expected.

In just one day, nearly four thousand people died!

This is just one area, all areas add up!

This is a horrific death toll.

There are not so many people there during the day.

Just at the moment of darkness, the death toll soared!

He knew that the cruelest things had happened to those babies, children, the elderly, and the disabled.

They do not have the ability to upgrade the wooden house, and they do not have the ability to move the wooden house one kilometer.

In the moment of darkness, everything was wiped out!

This is an extremely cruel thing.

Even a single like Qin Long felt like a big stone was weighing on his chest.

Not to mention those who are parents.

In their hearts, they were afraid that they were already dead at this time.

This is the damn apocalypse, so cruel!

"Ho, stab it, Jie Jie..."

Suddenly there were a lot of scary sounds outside.

Even the ground felt a little shaking.

Dark night falls, and the outside world feels like a swarm of demons dancing around.

All kinds of roars were heard!

There was also the sound of muscles being torn apart. The creatures of the night must be fighting each other!

Under this kind of sound, the timid person will be frightened to death.

Qin Long looked outside through the observation hole in the driving position.

Through the light of the burning zombies, I could vaguely see something.

Green eyes and red eyes appeared briefly outside the firelight.

Didn't see clearly what it was.

Creatures of the night are indeed afraid of fire.

As long as there was fire, they did not dare to approach the cabin.

Now, Qin Long feels that the importance of upgrading the wooden house should be given top priority.

As night falls, the temperature inside the cabin also drops sharply!
